evidence.review_notes: Confirmed against p49 of Unicomp FY2025 annual report, MD&A table 主营业务分地区情况, row 境内. notes: Unicomp FY2025 主营业务分地区情况 MD&A table, row 境内. evidence.review_notes: Confirmed against p233 of Unicomp H1 2026 report, same note-61(2) structure, 主营业务（分地区）row 境内. Re-extracted p233 with pdftotext -layout: prints 境内 617,944,798.54/358,622,179.41 and 境外 97,457,177.11/34,961,850.49, 合计 715,401,975.65/393,584,029.90 — exact match to the registered value 617944798.54. Verified the label-override in the row's own notes: the table immediately above states 主营业务 714,719,824.28 / 其他业务 682,151.37 / 合计 715,401,975.65, and 境内+境外=715,401,975.65 reproduces that grand 合计 (including 其他业务), not the smaller 主营业务-only figure of 714,719,824.28. The printed 主营业务（分地区）heading is therefore wrong about its own column's basis, and the residual test the integrator used to override it to source_reported_total_operating_revenue is correct — exactly the 'residual is the tell, better evidence than the table's title' rule in Extraction Failure Modes.

notes: Unicomp H1 2026 revenue-recognition note, row 境内. Despite the 主营业务 label, 境内+境外=715,401,975.65 matches the note's own grand total INCLUDING 其他业务收入 (682,151.37), not main-business revenue alone (714,719,824.28) -- residual test overrides the printed label; registered as source_reported_total_operating_revenue. See unicomp_source_defined_domestic_operating_revenue.
